name: Zhishi Mouyi Fengxue Guohou de Richang
original_name: 只是某一风雪过后的日常
source:
The story takes place in a future world in a parallel universe. After a series of global pandemics and nuclear wars, the Earth's population has been drastically reduced. The surviving humans have spontaneously formed communities and live in a manner similar to primitive societies.

One morning, after a snowstorm, Kalinda awakens from her sleep and opens her eyes to find her partner smiling at her...

"Good morning".

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1876690/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
故事发生在平行宇宙的未来世界。经过一系列全球流行病和核战争，地球人口急剧减少。幸存的人类自发地形成了群落，以类似于原始社会的方式生活。

一天早上，一场暴风雪过后，卡琳达从睡梦中醒来，睁开眼睛，发现她的伴侣正在对她微笑……

“早上好”。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1876690/]Steam[/url]]
